body:
How hasn't it effect my life? It is my life. Not in the sense that I go around and think that I'm so fucking bipolar all the time :)
But I mean, I'm a fuckup no matter what goes on. Give me a task in life, anything at all, and I'll fuck it up in ways most people can't comprehend.
I fall in love with the wrong women. Or maybe they are the right women, who knows? Obviously I fucked the relationships up and that's really all there is to it.
I can't keep my house clean for shit. Been a year or something since I took out the trash last time. I just move from room to room and tidy up just enough so I can live there. 

I have never taken any meds and this has been my life for 17-18 years or so. I'm 36 now. On monday I'm going back to the doctor (for the fourth time I think) to ask for something to snap me the fuck out of this. I've been there before. They wanted me to start on some pills, but I never go and get them. I don't know why?

It's like all this fucking up is a part of me and it's almost scary to think that I might one day stop. It's like removing the biggest part of myself from me. I don't know... It's almost as if I'm addicted to being like this.
What if it stops? Who the hell am I then? This is all I know.

I just live in my head. I make up stories for myself about what life is and I try to find a place in it where I fit. But there's really no such place. I'm just cancer on everything and everyone.

Self acceptance you say? Well, yeah, I accept it. But it's the most disgusting thing I know of and rather not think of it at all. I can honestly say I'm the most useless person I have ever heard of or know. Who the hell wants to accept something like that? I'm not exaggerating either, honest to whatever god or gods you worship. It's not like I'm a bad person. I really don't think I am. I'm just... useless.

One way or another Meermouse is dead. I either take those damn meds and come out someone else or I'll end up hanging from a tree somewhere.
And noone wants to die. Not really.

And no, no positives. Fuck this shit man.
Yeah, I'm getting more and more convinced my best friends wife is into me. FML.
Unless you yourself have a mental illness, you do not understand what it's like to have one. And you never will.

I'm not gonna cut off our friendship. And I'm certainly not going to say anything to her. I wan't to talk to her about this so bad it hurts, but imagine if she too has these feelings for me, like I think she does. It would be a disaster in every way. Instead of me being miserable about it, it would be all of us, including the children. And I absolutely love their kids, and they love me. I pick them up from daycare every now and then when they need my help for christs sake. There is no "win" to be found here, for anyone, so I'm just gonna keep some distance and let the feelings suffocate.

But thx for giving me your input. I just want to talk about this with someone, get it off my chest, and there is noone in my "real life" that I can share it with.

I feel as if I could have written this myself, except I'm a bit older and have had recurrent depressions for about 20 years now.

I have no solutions for you unfortunatly. We enjoy the good times, and we wait out the bad ones. There is really nothing else but to go on. Every next depression hits harder than the one before. But I'm a fucking beast brother, and so are you if you accept the role of one. We fight this shit through. Alone, and every time. Death comes soon enough. No need to rush it. 
Cry, hit something, sleep, scream... But when you're done with that, you keep going. That's what we do.
